description: Policy and rationale: docs/development/dependencies.md (Automated dependency updates).

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major devDependency updates once every check passes. 0.x packages stay manual because their minor releases may break.
Group and automerge non-major GitHub Actions updates and digest pins.
Workflow runtime versions (node-version, go-version, toolchain) are deliberate; CI runs at the supported Node floor.
pnpm overrides are security pins; a major can escape the parent's declared range (fast-uri must stay 3.x for ajv).
Keep Tauri plugins moving together across npm and Cargo. Core Tauri is grouped by monorepo:tauri.
Claude Agent SDK refreshes follow topics/provider-refresh.md and update yepAnywhere.claudeCode.claudeAgentSdkVersion; request them from the Dependency Dashboard.
The optional STT pixi environment is held to a known-good snapshot and is not exercised by CI; request updates from the Dependency Dashboard.
